name: Stefan Descheemaeker
current_role: Non-executive Director, Nomad Foods (CEO 2015-2025); Chairman, Verlinvest; Director, Oatly
profile: Belgian executive who ran Nomad Foods (Birds Eye, Iglo, Findus) as CEO from its 2015 acquisition of Iglo until retiring on 1 Jan 2026, staying on its board. Earlier he spent years at Interbrew/AB InBev (board member 2008-2019) and was Delhaize Group CFO then CEO Europe (2008-2013). He chairs Verlinvest, the Belgian investment firm and Oatly backer.
interesting_fact: At Interbrew he is credited with helping steer the 2004 Interbrew-AmBev merger that created InBev, the forerunner of AB InBev.
deep_cut_fact: Alongside his corporate career he has taught as a Professor of Business Strategy at the Universite Libre de Bruxelles (ULB).
notes: CEO handover to Dominic Brisby announced Oct 2025, effective 1 Jan 2026. Verlinvest (chairman) is a natural route for a food/consumer-investing angle; low public profile otherwise.
